title: Exit codes disagree across commands: run-epic exits 1 for a held run, run/watch exit 3; completed+PR exits 3 on a TTY
description:
resultExitCode (exit.go:105) knows only 0/4/1 and TestRunEpicJSONResultAgreesWithTheExitCode pins a finding_untriaged hold as 1, while run/watch exit ExitHeld=3 and SKILL.md says a held run exits 3. watchHoldAttention counts WaitMerge, so an interactive ticfac run of a completed epic with an open PR exits 3, while piped or --json it exits 0. Unify the table and test each path.

ticfac run epic-2jn created this tick by absorbing the finding 88e403106488f7b4eccf86041d897018452658ecd1a563cc948f2767b7993acb (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-xbp/attempt-32): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/88e403106488f7b4eccf86041d897018452658ecd1a563cc948f2767b7993acb.json on the run branch.
